tables.ULT_SCALE: scale label per ultimate, also compared as data in scaleLabelFor; shown only via abilityMeta -> skillDesc, which runs langMeta/langDesc over the meta line
tables.KIT_SCALE: scale label per kit skill, same path as ULT_SCALE (abilityMeta -> langMeta in skillDesc)
tables.GSPLIT_ROAD_NAME: English road data (L.name); the screen shows gsplitRoadName()/gsplitRoadShort() keys
tables.GSPLIT_ROAD_SHORT: English road data; the screen shows gsplitRoadShort() keys
tables.BOSS_CUES: English fallback; every display reads ewT('bosscue.'+key) first (bossCueFor, stage preview)
tables.CHAPTER_BOSS_CUE: English fallback; every display goes through chapterBossCueText / bossCueFor (bosscue.ch<n> keys)
tables.CHAPTER_BOSS_NAME: boss in-game names (proper names) for the {boss} var
tables.INTRO_LINES: English fallback + speaker names; introSay shows INTRO_KEYS (intro11.*) text
tables.FT_I18N: lookup table: English float word -> key (the English is the floatTexts data, drawn translated by ftShow)

functions._skillEffectStrRaw: builds the skill effect line from numbers; its only callers go through skillEffectStr, which returns langDesc(line) (templates gathered by content_tables.d/w3.json)
functions.summonShareStr: a fragment composed only into skill text that goes through langDesc (_skillEffectStrRaw via skillEffectStr, skillDesc level text)
functions.ccMetaSegs: control chips of abilityMeta; its only display is skillDesc, which runs langMeta (langDesc per ' · ' segment)
functions.scaleLabelFor: returns a scale label used as data (compared to 'Attack') and shown only through abilityMeta -> langMeta
functions.heroFormationDepth: role data ('Warrior') used as a lookup default, never shown
functions.dealDamage: damageProfile data compares ('Magic','Healer'); its float words (NOT THERE, MISS) are drawn translated by ftShow
functions.sfxGo: sound debug log reason (sfxNote), never shown
functions.sfxTailsOut: sound debug log reason (sfxFade), never shown
functions._fxCheck: console.warn FX miss debugging, never shown
functions.perfHUD: developer performance overlay (FPS / frame ms), dev only

patterns.why: requestId prefix sent to the server
